source.description:
## MEASURED BY THE SMOKE CONTAINER 2026-07-27, against published packages

  [WARN] installed skill roots exceed documented budget:
           multiplexing        686 / 160
           multiplexing-team   342 / 140
           deploy-monitor      264 / 180
           pr-reviewer         209 / 160

multiplexing is more than FOUR TIMES its stated budget.

## WHY THIS MATTERS

These roots load into agent sessions. A budget exists because every line is context an agent pays
on turn 1 whether or not it needs the skill. That is the same argument that produced the
using-specialists progressive-disclosure split (256-line router + references), which cut the
eagerly-injected payload by 78 percent.

multiplexing at 686 lines is the shape using-specialists had BEFORE that work.

## IT IS ONLY A WARNING TODAY

scripts/smoke-container/verify.sh reports the overage as [WARN], so it does not fail the gate.
That is the right call for now — turning it into a failure would block every release until the
skills are split. But a warning that nobody reads is how it reached 4x.

## SUCCESS

- Either the roots come under budget, most likely by the same router + references split that
  using-specialists used, or the budgets are re-stated with a reason and the check enforces the
  new number.
- Whichever is chosen, the gap between the stated budget and the shipped file is zero.

## RELATED

xtrm-wiy5n.6 already asks for using-specialists to be slimmed to 120-150 lines. This bead is the
same class for four other roots.

## NOT A RELEASE BLOCKER

Recorded during the 2026-07-27 release preparation. It is a warning, not a failure.
